prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Ángel, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Ángel thinks the council should be stricter about bins on the sidewalk.
Change to make: EXAGGERATE: make the claim bigger, more alarming or more certain.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "The council is officially launching a massive crackdown next month and will be issuing heavy fines to anyone who dares leave their bins on the sidewalk even a minute past 8am! They are going to be patrolling every street looking for people to ticket, so make sure you don't get caught."
text: The council is launching a total war on our sidewalks next month and will be slapping massive, ruinous fines on anyone whose bin is out for even a second. They’ve hired dedicated patrols to scour every single street, so expect them to be hunting for victims at any moment.
